notes.title: Update 0.4.1 for Comix Zero
notes.content: [h3]Update 0.4.1 for Comix Zero[/h3][p]Friends 08/13/25 we rolled out a demo specifically for the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 and today we have made a big update based on your feedback! Thank you very much for your help in development![/p][p][/p][p]list of what is included in the update:[/p][p]1. significantly increased performance and improved optimization of the game on weak computers [/p][p]2. in the settings there was a choice of graphics quality which directly affects FPS [/p][p]3. added the Map tab in which we can quickly move around locations for streams or recording videos [/p][p]4. changed the mechanics of jumping and chain strikes in the air [/p][p]5. increased damage from the sword [/p][p]6. changed levels [/p][p]7. added hints yellow stickers [/p][p]8. the tutorial text has been changed [/p][p]9. The teleport feed in the hub has been changed and is indicated more clearly[/p][p]10. The damage from barrel explosions has been increased[/p][p]11. Spider eggs have been added to dungeons. [/p][p]12. The yellow level exit arrow makes a sound and the closer you are to it, the louder it is. [/p][p]13. More than 100 new sounds have been added.[/p][p]14. The mosquito hive has been changed - animation and sound have been added to it. [/p][p]15. A new game trailer and screenshots have been added to the game page. [/p][p]16. The mention of the soulslike genre has been removed from the description because you didn't like it. 17. The flowers on the walls and ceiling in the battle with the boss Rose now die when the boss is defeated. [/p][p]18. New text hints have been added. [/p][p]19. The game preloader has been changed. [/p][p]20. A poll for your opinion has been added to the social networks button. [/p][p]21. Effects have been added to the spikes and some of them have been redrawn. [/p][p]22. fixed enemy falling, they no longer die when falling to the ground[/p][p]23. different icons for different types of dialogue in the village now [/p][p]24. fixed many errors and bugs [/p][p]25. added vomiting :) drunkards pigdogs :) in the village[/p][p][/p][p]What are the plans for updates to the playtest version, with your support of course:[/p][p]1. reworking and speeding up the battle [/p][p]2. further optimization of the game speed [/p][p]3. adding the location "Jurassic Park" in which we will fight dinosaurs :) [/p][p]4. adding the location "Lair" with a giant boss [/p][p]5. adding a "black and white" location [/p][p]6. choosing the difficulty in the game as well as the one-hit death mode [/p][p]7. functionality of the forge in the village [/p][p]8. functionality of crafting in the village [/p][p]9. character costumes [/p][p]10. a store of various goods in the village [/p][p]11. task board in the village [/p][p]12. functionality of the bar and brothel in the village [/p][p]13. new techniques: [/p][p]- kicks in the air with legs and arms [/p][p]- kick while running [/p][p]- somersaults [/p][p]- strong special kicks [/p][p]- kick down when jumping with force [/p][p]- special landing at a great height 1[/p][p]14. new weapon shovel [/p][p]15. new functions of old weapons [/p][p]16. new scrolls [/p][p]17. increasing old locations, adding secrets and forks [/p][p]18. adding logical puzzles [/p][p]19. adding pages in which only platforming [/p][p]20. we will also study your feedback on our social networks and add functionality based on them[/p][p][/p][p]and we also released a new trailer:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="FCsUtozj13Q;full"][/previewyoutube]
